name: claudespeak-windows
description: Reads a 1-3 sentence summary of each finished Claude Code reply aloud on Windows, one voice at a time across sessions. Free Edge TTS default with Kokoro-82M offline fallback; an optional paid API voice if you set a provider and key.

voice.title: TTS voice
voice.description: Voice id used by the chosen TTS provider (default: en-US-AriaNeural for Edge).

ttsProvider.title: TTS provider
ttsProvider.description: Optional paid API TTS provider. Leave empty for free Edge TTS with Kokoro fallback. If set, an apiKey is required and the free voices are disabled.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Optional API key for the chosen ttsProvider. Leave empty to use free Edge TTS. Never commit this: store it via /speak key or an env var instead.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Small fast model that turns a long reply into 1-3 spoken sentences.
